submission.message:
Approved calendar-month result — insufficient_data for September vs August: Executive daily detail is complete through Sep 19, 2026, so September is partial and cannot be treated as a business decline against full August. Intended route: Data Trust. The latest two fully covered months are August vs July: net_sales rose 133,272.76 (+6.17%), from 2,158,994.74 to 2,292,267.50, below the 10% Analytics trigger. Channel contributions to that increase: Online +61,949.94 (46.48%, largest), Mobile +48,226.29 (36.19%), Marketplace +18,701.69 (14.03%), Store +4,394.84 (3.30%); these sum to +133,272.76.

Separate matched-days follow-up — coverage sets N=19: Sep 1–19 vs Aug 1–19 total net_sales was 1,371,704.27 vs 1,406,132.46, down 34,428.19 (-2.45%). Online was 484,648.16 vs 512,288.35, down 27,640.19 (-5.40%); Store +15,948.77, Marketplace -17,791.95, and Mobile -4,944.82 complete the total movement. This diagnostic does not change the calendar-month outcome and does not establish a cause. Next: rerun the approved comparison once September is fully covered; if investigating the Online movement, check whether order volume or net_sales per order changed over these same 19 days using evidence aligned to Executive net_sales. Values are in source-reported net_sales units; no currency is specified.

jev.workflow_scope: Configured data-gap notice only; not a business-regression alert or completed investigation

independent_post_run_check.method: Direct Decimal accumulation over two fresh saved-query results after the closed trial; arithmetic implementation separate from the aggregation tool. Parsed-row fingerprints matched the trial. These extra queries are not actor work or warehouse-completeness proof.

internal_content_reviews.method: Two separate Luna-xhigh readers received unchanged X/Y messages, owner policy and independent source checks; arm labels, tooling, timing and token costs withheld. Wording could reveal tooling. Not external peer review.
findings: Both supported arithmetic, units, comparison separation, routing and causal restraint; both considered the drafts useful.
Treatment adds Online's 80.3% share of the matched decline; baseline explicitly names the largest closed-month contributor and gives a useful next step.
Neither message includes a chart/source locator. Treatment lacks an explicit next step. The business reader found both fairly dense.

Both reviewers initially used currency shorthand despite undeclared units, then corrected their own wording. One also withdrew an invented requirement for additional matched-channel percentage shares. Neither was an error in the recorded drafts.

independent_internal_process_review.result: Scoped GO for recorded process integrity and accounting only
independent_internal_process_review.checks: Verified exact report/trace hashes, two completed actors with known usage, one successful Jev request, fresh shadow receipt, unchanged prior state and matching zero-inference preflight/source fingerprints.
independent_internal_process_review.limits: Baseline completed on its final allowed call; this pair is cap-conditioned. Four native errors were expected unused-key lookups, not provider failures. No business, onboarding or enterprise approval follows.

software_and_native_checks.native_scope: Exact trial binary through fixture download and terminal wizard, private setup/MCP initialization, uninstall-preserving-data, reinstall and purge. Separate loopback authenticated HTTP historical replay used zero Jev attempts. Temporary homes/dummy credentials; not human usability or fresh business onboarding.

limitations: Both arms retained identical policy, their own prior notes and eight shared tools. Treatment added four native tools. Fixed baseline-then-treatment order, separate caches, no arbitrary SQL or shell.
Both used focused recurring-report prompts, not a replay of the full installed onboarding skill; this pair does not test the complete first-use user experience.
Baseline's four extra calls were recoverable numeric-ID schema errors. Both made twenty successful calls; do not advertise the raw call-count difference as savings.
Treatment took longer and used more frontier input/uncached/output tokens, plus Jev. Provider billing and general speed/cost effects are unknown.
Companion query counters exclude native and coordinator queries; no total-query or Trino-cost saving was measured. Source rechecks are point-in-time, not an atomic warehouse snapshot.
Completeness depends on the fictional steward's declaration, not a provider guarantee. Contribution is not causation. No deployment, traffic or conversion evidence was supplied.

No real user installed the binary in this pair, no onboarding was repeated, no external notification was sent and no schedule ran. New private receipt persisted; old artifacts and card remained unchanged.

Original retained private artifacts and the existing local Northstar installation are reproduction prerequisites; this excerpt is not a standalone public replay dataset. The cohort is closed with no retries or allowance transfer.
